question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Let the cat out of the bag
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (To reveal a secret)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Let the cat out of the bag"** means to reveal a secret or disclose information that was supposed to remain hidden. (राज़ खोलना)

 
 
• **Example:** She let the cat out of the bag when she accidentally mentioned the surprise party.
 
 
 
• It is often used in situations where someone unintentionally or intentionally reveals confidential or sensitive information. (गोपनीय जानकारी उजागर करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He let the cat out of the bag about the new project before the official announcement.
 
 
 
• Hence, the meaning of the idiom aligns with the correct answer, "To reveal a secret".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To keep a secret** (राज़ छुपाना): Refers to maintaining confidentiality and not disclosing any sensitive information.

 
 
• **Example:** He promised to keep the secret and not tell anyone about the plan.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To punish a cat** (बिल्ली को सज़ा देना): This option is irrelevant as the idiom does not refer to punishing a cat.
 
 
• **Example:** There is no relation between the idiom and this meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To release a pet cat** (पालतू बिल्ली को छोड़ना): This option is incorrect as the idiom does not involve releasing a cat.
 
 
• **Example:** This meaning does not align with the context of the idiom.
 
 

36:Tbe0,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
